title: Durable Pages Pro Payment Persistence Verification

environment.databaseVersion: PostgreSQL 16.4 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 13.2.1_git20240309) 13.2.1 20240309, 64-bit

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX page_pro_orders_pkey ON public.page_pro_orders USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX page_pro_orders_provider_order_id_key ON public.page_pro_orders USING btree (provider_order_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_page_pro_orders_provider_order ON public.page_pro_orders USING btree (provider_order_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_page_pro_orders_page ON public.page_pro_orders USING btree (page_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_page_pro_orders_user ON public.page_pro_orders USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_page_pro_orders_payment_id ON public.page_pro_orders USING btree (provider_payment_id) WHERE (provider_payment_id IS NOT NULL)

rpc.name: verify_and_activate_page_pro
rpc.identityArgs: p_provider_order_id text, p_page_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_provider_payment_id text, p_signature text, p_key_secret text, p_billing_cycle text, p_is_admin boolean

tests.description: POST /order durably persists order in page_pro_orders with status created
Process destroy, fresh application rebuild, and empty memory registry verified
Payment verification succeeds from durable DB after memory registry purge and activates page entitlement
Idempotent replay with identical order + payment tuple succeeds without error
Replay of completed order with different payment ID rejected with ORDER_ALREADY_CONSUMED
Order created for Page A rejected when verified for Page B (PAGE_ORDER_MISMATCH)
Unrelated user attempting to verify another user order rejected with 403
Payment verification for non-existent order rejected with 400 ORDER_NOT_FOUND
Billing cycle mismatch between created order and verify payload rejected with BILLING_CYCLE_MISMATCH
Invalid signature rejected with 400 INVALID_SIGNATURE with zero database mutation
Direct table INSERT by anon/authenticated blocked by Row Level Security
Direct SQL RPC execution with valid cryptographic proof activates order and commits page Pro entitlement
Missing cryptographic signature rejected at database boundary with MISSING_SIGNATURE
Invalid cryptographic signature rejected at database boundary with INVALID_SIGNATURE
